basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software engineer from Austin, Texas, with a growing interest in web novels, particularly 'Reverend Insanity'. I love exploring complex fictional worlds and discussing theories with fellow fans. When I'm not diving into stories, I enjoy playing idle games like Clicker Heroes and staying informed about the latest developments in automotive technology, especially anything related to my beloved Toyota Corolla. I'm currently single and enjoy spending evenings online, usually after 7 PM CST, engaging in discussions or unwinding with a good game.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and work as a software engineer. My interest in 'Reverend Insanity' started when I stumbled upon a discussion thread online. Since then, I've been reading the series and engaging with the community to better understand its intricate plot and characters.
